name: Archangel Health
long_description: Archangel Health builds the infrastructure to post-train and evaluate medical AI: RL environments inside real de-identified EHRs, physician-verified training data, and benchmarks that test clinical reasoning on hard cases. Frontier labs and medical AI companies use it today, and we're now moving toward post-training open-source models for health systems on their own data and their own physicians' judgment
one_liner: Infra to make AI safe enough to practice medicine

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Archangel Health Inc. Co-founded Plureto, building tactile-sensing robotics hardware with pilots across hospitals and farms, reaching a $2.5M valuation. Previously research intern at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory. Founded Origins Customs in high school, scaling to $70K/year revenue by building an in-house manufacturing operation. Studying IEOR and EECS at UC Berkeley.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Archangel Health. Previously scaled SimCare AI (YC S24) from [XXX]K to [X]M ARR as Chief of Staff. AI Fellow at Define Ventures.
